name: Inaccessible
definition: Evidence exists but access is restricted or unavailable

name: Stale
definition: Evidence does not represent current state

name: Coverage gap
definition: Required population, state, period or scenario not represented

name: Integrity uncertain
definition: Alteration or custody cannot be ruled out

name: Interpretation unresolved
definition: Competent reviewers cannot yet determine meaning

name: Dependency unknown
definition: Evidence cannot establish a material external/shared dependency
